Method of Attack: SQL injection exploits in vulnerable modules
Uploading a web shell (blm.php) to execute commands remotely
Injecting fake payment forms on checkout pages to steal payment card details
Attack Vector: Exploitation of SQL injection vulnerabilities in modules
POST request to vulnerable endpoint followed by parameter-less GET request to homepage

Activation of MySQL Smarty cache storage
Entries in web server access logs indicating compromise
Date of Discovery: Reported last Friday before the article date
